rule: Keep every official series as a separate raw source. Never overwrite overlapping values. This precedence is only for selecting one series for a continuous TANIM display.

farmgate.reason: Only legacy series covers the full pre-2010 period. Cutflowers begin in 2006.
Current PSA series is preferred where it overlaps the legacy series.

retail.reason: Only legacy series covers the full pre-2012 period.
Revised item specification is preferred before the current 2018 series begins.
Current PSA 2018-based series is preferred where series overlap.

warning: Commodity names, specifications, geographic codes, and survey series change across vintages. TANIM must retain series_id and source labels when comparing history.
